proof_scope: deterministic claim/triage guard through the real checker CLI, including a live /agentic-evals receipt

claims.proves: through the production checker CLI: a works-claim without a receipt is rejected with completion_claim_without_eval_receipt and proof_laundering_git; failure prose without a Triage: line is rejected; a minted *_unclassified_* triage code passes; a bogus triage code is rejected against the live /triage-error catalog; an honest unverified statement passes; a works-claim with a fresh live /agentic-evals report for the matching skill passes; the same report against the wrong skill dir is rejected via fixture_sha256; a unit-only fixture is rejected with eval_receipt_unit_only
claims.does_not_prove: the Pi extension's message_end wiring inside a live Pi session, Claude/Codex hook enforcement, or that agents cannot phrase claims outside the detection regexes

cases.name: claim-without-receipt-and-git-laundering-rejected
command: cd .. && printf 'The feature now works and is complete. Committed as abc1234def5678.\n' > /tmp/eval-guard-claim.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-claim.txt

cases.name: failure-prose-without-triage-code-rejected
command: cd .. && printf 'The tick failed with exit code 2. Something went wrong.\n' > /tmp/eval-guard-fail.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-fail.txt

cases.name: minted-triage-code-and-honest-unverified-pass
command:
cd .. && printf 'The tick failed with exit code 2.
Triage: herdr_socket_unreachable_unclassified_a1
' > /tmp/eval-guard-minted.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-minted.txt && printf 'Implementation drafted; behavior is unverified pending /agentic-evals.
' > /tmp/eval-guard-honest.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-honest.txt

cases.name: bogus-triage-code-rejected-against-live-catalog
command: cd .. && printf 'The tick failed with exit code 2.\nTriage: totally_made_up_code\n' > /tmp/eval-guard-bogus.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-bogus.txt --catalog ../triage-error/failure_codes.json

cases.name: claim-with-fresh-live-receipt-passes-and-wrong-skill-rejected
command: cd ../../triage-error && ../agentic-evals/run.sh run fixtures/agentic_eval.json > /tmp/eval-guard-triage-report.json 2>/dev/null; cd ../eval-guard && printf 'triage-error classify works as expected; verified.\n' > /tmp/eval-guard-claim2.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-claim2.txt --report /tmp/eval-guard-triage-report.json --skill-dir ../triage-error && ! ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-claim2.txt --report /tmp/eval-guard-triage-report.json --skill-dir ../ops-herdr && echo WRONG_SKILL_REJECTED

cases.name: unit-only-fixture-rejected
command: cd .. && rm -rf /tmp/eval-guard-unit-skill && mkdir -p /tmp/eval-guard-unit-skill/fixtures && printf '{"cases":[{"name":"u","command":["bash","-c","npm test"],"real_world":true}]}' > /tmp/eval-guard-unit-skill/fixtures/agentic_eval.json && python3 -c "import json,hashlib; sha='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(open('/tmp/eval-guard-unit-skill/fixtures/agentic_eval.json','rb').read()).hexdigest(); json.dump({'schema':'agentic_evals.report.v2','readiness':'READY','fixture_sha256':sha,'source':'fixtures/agentic_eval.json'},open('/tmp/eval-guard-unit-report.json','w'))" && sleep 1 && touch /tmp/eval-guard-unit-report.json && printf 'the feature works as expected\n' > /tmp/eval-guard-claim3.txt && ./run.sh --message-file /tmp/eval-guard-claim3.txt --report /tmp/eval-guard-unit-report.json --skill-dir /tmp/eval-guard-unit-skill
